selected_next_action.title: Review the evidence with the responsible researcher
selected_next_action.detail: The researcher decides which interpretation and follow-up are appropriate. The app does not convert a model preference or a QC metric into a biological conclusion.

limits: One synthetic two-stage review passed structural/schema and evidence checks. It does not establish model usefulness, biological validity, broad reliability or public model availability. No private assay data was used. A subsequent browser run failed format validation; do not treat the initial success as a reliability benchmark.

subsequent_local_browser_check.visible_message: The model response did not follow the required format. No model result was accepted.
